cells.gaps: No source found says services on two different satellite networks are on sale; the Eutelsat low-earth-orbit service Mercury sells and Twoobii are both OneWeb, and no sale over ANGOSAT-2 has been found.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-13, 4 -> 3: Eutelsat's low-earth-orbit service (AGO-010) is OneWeb, the network Twoobii sells (AGO-011), so one network is on sale, not two. ANGOSAT-2 is licensed for resale (AGO-008) but no sale on it has been found.
